GMB.note: Digital ID is only a future intention (there will be a time), nothing delivered.
No link between civil register and ID stated.
Business registration appears only as one item of a planned application app; no register stated.
Birth certificate appears only as an application item of a planned app; no civil register system stated.

facts.fact: Information minister Ismaila Ceesay, at a graduation of Immigration officers who completed the Advanced Diploma in Computer Networking at Suitin Institute, said government is committed to building civil servants' technology capacities.
facts.system: Advanced Diploma in Computer Networking (Suitin Institute)

facts.fact: Minister Ceesay said government is working on a one-stop-shop government service platform, starting with ID card application, birth certificate, business registration, passport and driver's licence applications, through an app.

GMB.note: No enrolment count or share stated.
Who operates or maintains the ID system is not stated.
No register keyed on the ID number stated.
Only says new ID cards being printed are digital; no unique-identity system, biometrics or certification stated.
No local civil registration office entry stated.
